_about: Tours writer (Phase 1b). Terms first used on the tour pages. Reuse ids from core.json, basics.json, platform.json and code.json; do not redefine them here.

engine-step.short: One call of LLMEngine.step(): schedule a batch, run the model once on the device, sample, and update the requests. Generation is a loop of steps.
engine-step.long: LLM._run_engine() calls step() until no request is unfinished ({{cite deepinfer/entrypoints/llm.py:176-186}}).

tokenizer.short: The program that cuts text into tokens and gives each token an integer id. It also turns ids back into text (decode).
tokenizer.long: DeepInfer loads the Hugging Face tokenizer of the checkpoint with get_hf_tokenizer ({{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/tokenizer.py:77-121}}).

eos-token.short: End of sequence: a special token that tells the engine to stop a request. In the release tokenizer, EOS has id 1 and BOS (begin of sequence) has id 0.
eos-token.long: Checked in {{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/tokenizer.py:36-39}}. The scheduler stops a request at EOS unless ignore_eos is set ({{cite csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp:1038-1041}}).

sampling-params.short: The settings of one request: temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens, seed and more. The engine copies them into the C++ sequence once.
sampling-params.long: Defined in {{cite deepinfer/sampling_params.py:13-53}}. The C++ side copies the values in SamplingScalars::capture ({{cite csrc/engine/sequence.hpp:103-115}}).

scheduler.short: The C++ object that decides, in each engine step, which sequences run, how many tokens each one sends, and which KV blocks each one gets.

chunked-prefill.short: Splitting a long prompt into parts that run in several prefill steps, so that one step never has more than max_num_batched_tokens tokens.
chunked-prefill.long: The cut is in {{cite csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp:470-475}}. Each chunk goes through the sampler, but only the token of the last chunk becomes an output ({{cite csrc/engine/prepare_sample.cpp:173-174}}, {{cite csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp:1011-1020}}).

structured-output.short: Output that must follow a grammar, for example a JSON schema. A matcher masks every token that the grammar does not allow.
structured-output.long: Requests with so_args get a matcher from a thread pool before they enter the scheduler ({{cite deepinfer/engine/llm_engine.py:606-630}}).

context-parallelism.short: Several devices share the tokens of one long prefill. In DeepInfer, CP ranks are extra worker processes that receive their inputs from the driver.
context-parallelism.long: The driver broadcasts the input metadata to the other CP ranks ({{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:200-212}}).

zos.short: Zero-overhead scheduling. The CPU prepares and post-processes one step while the device runs the next, so the CPU work does not stop the device.
zos.long: On by default for the NORMAL engine ({{cite deepinfer/engine/arg_utils.py:51-55}}). The worker keeps a decode step and post-processes it during the next step ({{cite deepinfer/worker/worker.py:182-187}}).

cuda-graph.short: A recording of all kernel launches of one forward pass for a fixed batch size. A replay starts all kernels with one call, so the CPU cost is small.
cuda-graph.long: DeepInfer replays a graph in decode steps ({{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:326-329}}).

hidden-state.short: The vector that represents one token inside the model. The embedding makes it from the token id; each layer changes it.

logits.short: One raw score per vocabulary token. Softmax turns the scores into probabilities. DeepInfer computes them in float32 only for the rows that it samples.

logprob.short: The natural logarithm of the probability of a token. Each RequestOutput carries the logprob of its token and, on request, of the best alternatives.

speculative-decoding.short: A small module guesses the next tokens (drafts). The main model checks all drafts in one step and keeps the correct prefix, so one step can make several tokens.

draft-token.short: A guessed next token from the MTP module. The next decode step sends it as input, and the sampler accepts or rejects it.

mtp.short: Multi-token prediction: a module that predicts more than one next token. DeepInfer uses DFlash as its MTP module. DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE sets the number of drafts (default 5).

dflash.short: The draft module of DeepInfer. In each decode step, the sampler calls it once after the draft check, and it proposes the drafts for the next step.
